knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A heater transfers heat to water passing through it, so flow is required. The handbook makes this point directly.
A tripped device signals a fault or low flow. The cause is found, and gas work is referred to a licensed person.
Gas installation needs a registered person. This lesson does not confirm Australian licensing, which must be checked.

practicalCriteria: Pump flow is observed and recorded before heater settings are read
Heat pump air intake and outlet are checked and cleared where blocked
Any tripped safety device is recorded with the cause identified or referred, and not reset repeatedly
No installation, connection or adjustment of gas or electrical parts is attempted
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Heater check record from one supervised visit
Referral note for any gas, electrical or oil concern
stopWorkCriteria: Heater operated with no water flow
Safety device bypassed, taped or removed
Gas or electrical parts connected, adjusted or repaired without a licensed person
Heat pump air path blocked and left that way
